services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Visit this fall for final field trips at MPM! The last day we will host field trips will be December 11, 2026. We recommend reservations six weeks in advance. We cannot guarantee first-choice dates due to capacities. School group rates are available Monday through Friday (excluding Tuesdays and Kohl’s Thank You Thursdays). To qualify for the school group discount, you must make a purchase for a minimum of 10 students and belong to an educational organization. Field trips must be booked and paid for at least two weeks in advance to receive discounted admission rates.
